_about: A Cloud of Witnesses for the Royal Prerogatives of Jesus Christ: the last speeches and testimonies of the Covenanters who suffered from 1680, reprinted from the original editions with notes by John H. Thomson (Edinburgh: Oliphant, Anderson & Ferrier, 1871). A compilation with no single author, so the name check looks for its editor, Thomson. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
